sports.h3: Zverev and Djokovic on quarter-final course in Beijing
sports.summary: Monday's China Open draw puts US Open champion Zverev and six-time winner Djokovic in the same quarter.
body: Top seed Zverev opens against lefty Cameron Norrie, while Djokovic, unbeaten in 29 Beijing matches, starts against Nuno Borges on his first visit since 2015.
With Sinner absent and dropping 500 points, Zverev can close in on the year-end No. 1 spot. Medvedev faces a qualifier and Mensik meets Bublik in round one.

sports.h3: Alcaraz opens Tokyo defence against Michelsen
sports.summary: The champion meets the in-form US Open quarter-finalist first up, while Nishikori plays Tiafoe in his Tokyo farewell.
body: Alcaraz, back from a wrist injury, could face Tommy Paul in the quarters and Taylor Fritz in a repeat of last year's final. Michelsen has never played him.
Two-time champion Kei Nishikori is competing in Tokyo for the final time against second seed Tiafoe. Holger Rune returns to the tour against Kyrian Jacquet after his Achilles injury.

sports.h3: Rybakina tops China Open field, Gauff and Swiatek could clash
sports.summary: The WTA 1000 draw in Beijing sets up a possible quarter-final between two former champions.
body: World No. 1 and US Open winner Rybakina leads the 96-player field ahead of Sabalenka, Gauff and Andreeva. Swiatek leads Gauff 11-5 but lost their only 2026 meeting.
Main draw play starts Wednesday 30 September after qualifying ends today. Sabalenka could meet Osaka in the last eight for the fifth time this season.

sports.h3: Medvedev and Rublev meet in Hangzhou final
sports.summary: The top two seeds contest the title on Tuesday after straight-sets semi-final wins.
body: Rublev beat Kyrian Jacquet 7-6, 6-1 for his 400th tour-level win, while Medvedev saw off Roman Safiullin 7-5, 6-4 without dropping a set all week.
Medvedev leads the head-to-head 8-2 and won all three of their 2023 meetings in straight sets. Both head to Beijing next.

sports.h3: Verstappen awaits engine verdict before Sepang
sports.summary: Red Bull is still analysing Verstappen's power unit, while Colapinto already carries a five-place grid drop.
body: No penalty has been decided for Verstappen yet, but an engine change could push him down the grid. Colapinto was penalised for the Baku crash that eliminated Norris and Gasly.
F1 returns to track at Sepang on Friday 2 October. Rain risk and a heat index near 40C are forecast for the relocated Bahrain Grand Prix.

sports.h3: Norris apologises to Colapinto and drops ban call
sports.summary: The McLaren driver walked back his demand for a race ban after their Baku collision.
body: Norris had called for Colapinto to be banned after being taken out in Azerbaijan. He has now apologised and withdrawn that call.
McLaren are expected to be strong at high-speed Sepang. Cadillac is separately investigating Bottas's late Baku crash.

sports.h3: Russell says his title form came too late
sports.summary: Fresh from winning in Baku, Russell admitted his best form arrived late in the season.
body: Russell trails Mercedes teammate Antonelli 302 to 236 after cutting the gap by 15 points in Azerbaijan. He believes an earlier peak would have left him better placed.
Sepang hosts its first F1 race since 2017 on Sunday. Pirelli has brought the C2 to C4 compounds for an abrasive surface that has not been resurfaced.

sports.h3: Xavi demands better pressing before Greece trip
sports.summary: After a first win in Serbia, the Oranje coach wants a sharper press when his side visits group leaders Greece on Thursday.
body: Xavi said the three points mattered most but admitted the first-half pressing in Belgrade was poor. He praised two-goal Mexx Meerdink for his work rate as well as his finishing.
The Netherlands play in Greece on 1 October, then host Serbia on 4 October. PSV defender Geertruida has left the camp injured and was not replaced.

sports.h3: Tienpont and Walta reach double-handed worlds final
sports.summary: The Dutch pair qualified directly for Wednesday's winner-takes-all offshore final in Marseille.
body: Simeon Tienpont and Christiane Walta took fourth in the opening 90-mile qualifier after a bold starboard-tack call. France's Pratt and Radulic won it, and Belgium led the second qualifier.
Eleven Sun Fast 30 crews will contest a planned 48-hour final, with the event ending on 2 October. The final spot was due to be decided in Monday's repechage.

sports.h3: Musumeci wants to vacate UFC BJJ belt for MMA
sports.summary: After outpointing Bryce Mitchell at UFC BJJ 11, the bantamweight champion says the title no longer motivates him.
body: Musumeci won a unanimous decision in a match played without leg locks, leaning on wrestling instead. He plans to open talks with the UFC about giving up the belt he has held since June 2025.
He says he has already won every title he wanted in his weight class. His MMA debut is targeted for November or December.

sports.h3: Fowler keeps UFC BJJ title after split draw with Rodriguez
sports.summary: The light heavyweight rematch in Las Vegas ended level, so Mason Fowler retains his belt.
body: Nick Rodriguez had said the payday mattered more to him than the belt and promised a faster pace. The judges could not separate the pair at the Meta Apex.
Elsewhere on the card, Jay Rodriguez submitted Kevin Beuhring with an inverted D'Arce and Mason Stritzel won by heel hook.

consumer-tech.h3: VW confirms ID. Tiguan to replace ID.4 and ID.5
consumer-tech.summary: Volkswagen's best-selling SUV goes electric in 2027, with an official debut due in early October.
body: The ID.4 and ID.5 have sold over 950,000 units since 2021. Camouflaged prototype images show a boxier shape close to the combustion Tiguan and pop-out door handles.
Sales start in Europe in early 2027, with the US to follow. The cabin is expected to bring back physical buttons, plus better range and charging.

consumer-tech.h3: Storms threaten Tesla's Roadster demo on 1 October
consumer-tech.summary: Tesla told invitees the outdoor hover demonstration could be rescheduled due to weather.
body: The event near Waco relies on a SpaceX cold gas thruster package and must be held outside. Forecasts show an 82% chance of rain with thunderstorms and strong gusts.
The next-gen Roadster was unveiled in 2017 and has slipped repeatedly since. No backup date has been given.

consumer-tech.h3: Wall Street split on Tesla Q3 deliveries
consumer-tech.summary: Bank forecasts range from about 422,000 to 482,000 cars ahead of Friday's report.
body: JPMorgan and Goldman both cut estimates after a weak August in the US and China. Nearly every forecast implies a drop from last year's record 497,099.
Analysts badly underestimated Q2, when Tesla beat consensus by 74,000 units. High fuel prices may be offsetting the lost US tax credit.

consumer-tech.h3: BYD's cheapest EV grows into the Great Seagull
consumer-tech.summary: The second-generation hatch, sold in Europe as the Dolphin Surf, gets much bigger and more powerful.
body: Filings show it is 425mm longer with a 95 kW motor, up from 55 kW. New images suggest a rear motor, a frunk and roof LiDAR on some test cars.
BYD plans a China launch by end of 2026. A European version could cost around 30,000 euros, up from 22,900.

consumer-tech.h3: Chery's Omoda and Jaecoo set Canada launch
consumer-tech.summary: The Chinese brands will arrive in late 2026 under Canada's new low-tariff quota.
body: A teaser site confirms the timing but no models, prices or dealers yet. The Jaecoo E5 compact SUV has been spotted testing in Ontario.
Canada cut its Chinese EV tariff to 6.1% for up to 49,000 vehicles a year. BYD is also targeting a late 2026 Canadian start.

consumer-tech.h3: Gemini fully replaces Google Assistant on Android
consumer-tech.summary: The switch-back option is gone and Assistant has vanished on phones in the US and Europe.
body: The Gemini app no longer offers a way back to Assistant, and the change covers tablets, Wear OS, headphones and Android Auto. Long-pressing the power button now calls Gemini.
Nest speakers and smart displays keep Assistant for now. The shutdown had slipped from 2025 into 2026.

consumer-tech.h3: iOS 27.0.1 fixes iPhone 18 Pro Face ID reboots
consumer-tech.summary: Apple's first iOS 27 patch targets crashes and a camera artifact on its newest phones.
body: iPhone 18 Pro models could restart when Face ID failed, and some 2x photos showed a color artifact. A bug freezing the touchscreen when opening both control panels is also fixed.
iPadOS 27.0.1 arrived too, and iOS 26.7.1 brings security fixes for iPhones still on the older release.

consumer-tech.h3: AI agent Instinct raises $1B at $10B valuation
consumer-tech.summary: The texting-based assistant quadrupled its valuation in a month.
body: Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue joined the Series C for the startup, which only opened invite-only access in August. It books, buys and makes phone calls on users' behalf.
Privacy worries forced an early policy rewrite, and Meta's Muse agent now tops US app stores. Instinct still has no mobile app.

consumer-tech.h3: Honor Magic9 Pro Max launches at RMB 6,499
consumer-tech.summary: Honor's new flagship pairs two 200MP cameras with ARRI cinema tools and an 8,800mAh battery.
body: The phone runs a top Snapdragon chip, claims 10,000-nit peak brightness and records ARRI-mode 4K at 60fps. It charges at 100W wired and 80W wireless.
Pricing in China starts around $910 with up to 1TB storage. It ships with MagicOS 11 on Android 17 and IP69K protection.

consumer-tech.h3: Apple tests four designs for a lighter Vision Pro
consumer-tech.summary: Bloomberg says a new headset project, N224, could arrive in late 2028 or early 2029.
body: One concept moves compute and battery into an external puck like Meta's new VR glasses, though some executives prefer an all-in-one design. Apple is also trying plastic and titanium to cut weight.
The project follows the shelved Vision Air and may succeed the M5 model rather than undercut it.

consumer-tech.h3: Gemini can now control Pixel Buds settings
consumer-tech.summary: A Pixel Buds app update lets voice commands change EQ, noise cancelling and touch controls.
body: Pixel Buds now appear as a Gemini Connected App, so asking for more bass or ANC works directly. The update is rolling out widely on the Play Store.
Dynamic ANC for Pixel Buds Pro 2, Pixel Watch sleep sync and tap-to-translate likely need a firmware update.
